name: Date extract
description: Date extract (CAS 90027-90-0 ), also marketed as Hurma Ekstrakt in certain regional markets, is derived from the fruit of Phoenix dactylifera and concentrated for use across food, cosmetic, and nutraceutical manufacturing. It delivers natural sweetness, antioxidant activity, and moisture-retaining properties that replace or complement synthetic additives in finished formulations. In food and beverage production, it functions as a natural flavoring agent. It is used in energy bars, confectionery, dairy products, and functional drinks where clean-label positioning is a priority. Nutraceutical and supplement manufacturers incorporate it as a nutrient-dense botanical extract. The extract leverages its natural sugar profile and polyphenol content for health-oriented product lines. In cosmetic and personal care formulations, it acts as a humectant and conditioning agent in creams and serums. It is also utilized in hair care products for its moisturizing benefits. Pharmaceutical applications include its use as a natural excipient or flavoring component in oral dosage forms and syrups. Date extract is supplied as a liquid concentrate or spray-dried powder, with powder forms preferred for dry blending and encapsulation applications. Food-grade and cosmetic-grade specifications are the most common. Standardization varies by supplier based on Brix levels or polyphenol content.
